name: lawson-digital-solutions
description: Lawson Digital Solutions — website, enquiries and staff portal (Next.js + NestJS + SQLite)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.seed: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.seed:reset: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run seed:reset
